description: Find pets from wishes in the person's own words, in any language (“a calm small dog good with kids near Seattle”). Use it for wishes listings rarely state, like calm or good with kids: each pet's match[] says stated or not_stated, and pets that do not say are left out and counted in not_stated unless include_unknown=true. The answer's understood.chips say what was searched; drop a wrong one with off=[chip id]. Found pets (found:true) are not adoptable. Prefer find_pets for structured values.

country.description: TW (Taiwan), US (King County WA and Montgomery County MD only), ES (Zaragoza) or AT (Vienna, found pets only)

include_unknown.description: Also include pets whose listing does not say whether they are good with dogs/cats/kids (they are marked not_stated)

lang.description: The person's language: en, es, zh-Hant, zh-Hans, ko, ja, vi, fr, ar, tl (default en)

near.description: Where, if it is not in the query: a US ZIP (98101, 20850), lat,lon, a Taiwan place, Zaragoza or Wien

off.description: Chip ids from a previous answer's understood.chips to leave out, e.g. ["good_with:kids"]

query.description: What the person wants, in their own words and language, e.g. “a senior dog in Zaragoza”, “a friendly cat near 98101”, “小型犬 台北”

name: search_by_description
title: Search by description
